process_issues.description: Running ESLint and Playwright concurrently in the same mobile worktree let Playwright recreate test-results while ESLint traversed it.
process_issues.detected_by: ESLint failed with ENOENT while scanning apps/mobile/test-results; serial execution passed.

failure_output: Playwright timed out clicking settings-reconnect-button because the button detached repeatedly while each settings edit triggered an automatic reconnect. The first parallel static run also hit ENOENT while ESLint scanned test-results as Playwright recreated it.
suggested_follow_up: Keep the prefixed-URL reconnect flow in the full aggregate browser gate and serialize ESLint with Playwright whenever both touch test-results.
